caption: The drawing depicts a wooden rocking chair, rendered in realistic detail against a plain, light-colored background. The chair features a high back with vertical spindles and two horizontal rails at the top and bottom. The backrest and seat are both made of a woven cane material in a light straw-yellow color. The chair's frame, including the arms, legs, and rockers, is a medium brown wood, with turned and carved elements on the arm supports and legs. The chair rests on two curved rockers, also in brown wood, connected by horizontal braces. The artist's signature, “Adele Brooks,” appears in small letters below the chair on the lower right side of the image.
title: Shaker Rocking Chair
